notes.subject: dunbagatigi
notes.rationale: זולל kɔrɔ ye 'ka sago joo, ka fɛn wɛrɛw joo' ye; 'dunbagatigi' (min bɛ dun ka bon) ye a nɔgɔya

notes.subject: diwɛnminbagatigi
notes.rationale: וסבא kɔrɔ fana bɛ fɔ 'dɔgɔkɔrɔbali' (carousal) ye, diwɛn dɔrɔn tɛ

notes.subject: ye
notes.rationale: Bamanankan kɔrɔdaɲɛw (ye…ye) min Hebrew tɛ foyi fɔ o kama

notes.subject: den kunbali sariya
notes.rationale: סורר ומורה — 'min bɛ tila ani min bɛ bassa': daɲɛw fila fila-fila de, nka u bɛ kɛ daɲɛ kelen ye 'ka kɛ kunbali ye' la

translation: Ka kɛlɛkɛsibagaw ma dugu in tɔgɔ ko: Den nin ye an denkɛ ye, a bɛɛ bɛ tila-tilali ani a tɛ an ka kan mɛn; a ye dunbagatigi ye, a ye diwɛnminbagatigi ye.

tokens.gloss: Den nin ye an denkɛ ye
